A [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]], '''Lavisar''' was once part of a larger high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] world. It was a medium-sized world of reddish-brown rock with an abundance of heavy metal ores and a few dark seas and abundant [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and refining industries. It remained neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] until conquered by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. It was the headquarters of [[Skyrung Manufacturing]], a licensed builder of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttles]]. The main port city was known as [[Syward]].

Lavisar was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] swordsman [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]].
